description: Use collection=public-research for public-source profiles with menus, add-ons, stylist information and policies; get_merchant returns the full public_research object. Salons covered (San Francisco), ordered profiled, detailed, then listed, with depth, neighborhood, price floor and range, stylist count, availability basis and freshness, last_verified_at and verification date. Paginated: limit (default 50, max 200), offset, depth=profiled|detailed|listed.

depth.description: profiled = booking-system depth; detailed = priced menu + booking link + hours or durations; listed = the rest
